messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — onboarding call tomorrow with FinSys security team (PSQ + live demo). They called out RBAC scoping, cross-tenant KMS questions, and evidence for incident response timelines. Can we do a very short pre-call thread to divvy up artifacts? Need: RBAC change logs, KMS provenance, SIEM export flow, vuln->deploy chain, IR timelines. Who can pick what?

devon: I can own RBAC change logs + SIEM export. Do we have an automated snapshot for role changes? We store `audit.role_changes` in the audit store but need to confirm retention and per-tenant partitioning.

shiv: I'll take KMS key provenance + rotation logs. For on-prem HSMs we can surface attestation certs. Quick question: do they require tenant-unique CMKs or envelope keys backed by a shared platform key? That affects what artifacts we deliver.

jane: I'll take vuln triage evidence and IR timeline artifacts. We have the IR runbook (1h ack, 24h mitigation target, RCA in 7d). Can we share that SLA summary and one redacted drill timeline?

maria: FinSys specifically asked for "proof RBAC changes are auditable per tenant" and someone to attest this during the call. @devon can you confirm we can produce per-tenant snapshots and a live query in the console?

devon: Yes — audit store is partitioned by tenant_id. Example query to show during demo: ```select * from audit where tenant_id='T-12345' and event='role_change' order by ts desc limit 10;``` We can snapshot results as CSV and upload to the preflight folder. Retention on enterprise tier is 365 days.

shiv: KMS notes: Hosted/Dedicated use envelope encryption with tenant CMKs in cloud KMS. Private supports BYOK/HSM. I can prepare `kms-export.json` with key metadata (key_id, creation_ts, rotation_policy) and rotation event logs. If QSA wants HSM attestation, we can include the attestation certificate chain and HSM firmware version.

jane: For vuln->deploy linkage: we have JIRA -> CI -> canary release links. I'll pull a redacted chain for a recently resolved CVE (JIRA-7823) showing ticket -> branch -> CI run -> canary tag -> final rollout. Also include whether any rollbacks occurred.

maria: They also asked about SIEM ingestion options and proof of delivery to their collector. @devon, can you outline the supported patterns (syslog over TLS to their collector, S3 export with signed URLs, and pull-based APIs)? Could we prepare a short config sample?

devon: Yep. We'll provide: 1) rsyslog TLS sample to point to their collector, 2) S3 export config example with lifecycle and encryption notes, 3) a short diagram of log flow. I'll add an example rsyslog fragment and a note on guaranteed delivery windows.

shiv: One operational note for KMS audit evidence: QSA often requests proof of KMS API usage (e.g., `GenerateDataKey`, `Decrypt`, `GetKeyPolicy`) for a given date range. We can export those events from the audit store. Also confirm whether they want raw logs or redacted extracts.

jane: On IR timelines, we shouldn't expose internal priority scoring. We can offer a customer-facing SLA doc: initial ack within 1h, mitigation plan for critical within 72h, RCA within 7 days. I'll attach a redacted drill timeline that shows acknowledgement, mitigation steps, and postmortem links.

maria: Also they want explicit linkage between vulnerability ticket and deployment rollouts (audit chain). @jane please include the JIRA ticket id, branch name, CI run id, canary tag and final commit sha (redacted hostnames ok).

jane: Will do — pulling the chain now. Will redact hostnames and PII. Upload target: preflight/finsec/3332104567/ by 17:00 PT.

devon: I'll upload RBAC CSV snapshot + SIEM config to the same folder by 16:30 PT. Also preparing a 2-min live demo script for the console query.

shiv: KMS metadata + attestation certs into preflight by 18:00 PT. I'll include a `kms-README.md` describing key custody model (platform CMKs vs tenant BYOK), rotation cadence, and exported API logs to look for.

maria: Can everyone confirm? FinSys call is 10:00 PT tomorrow. I'll consolidate artifacts into an index and draft the call script. If you need access to the preflight bucket to upload, ping me and I'll grant temporary perms.

jane: :thumbsup: Confirmed — JIRA chain + redacted RCA by 17:00.

devon: Confirmed. RBAC + SIEM by 16:30.

shiv: Confirmed. KMS artifacts by 18:00. Also recommend we prepare a one-slide diagram mapping tenant flow and key custody — QSA likes visuals.

deploy-bot: Reminder — calendar invite posted to #finsec-call tomorrow 10:00 PT. Link: https://meet.example.com/finsec-call-3332104567

maria: Thanks team. I'll post the consolidated preflight index once uploads are in. If anyone needs escalated read perms on the preflight bucket, DM me and I'll grant a time-limited role.
